repo_notes.content: tank-cq-level is a Raspberry Pi Zero W automation project that monitors a CQRobot optical water-level sensor (GPIO BCM pin 18) and turns a pump on/off via a Digital Loggers smart PDU when an AC chiller condensation tank is full. Source is organized as versioned snapshots (0.0 through 0.5), not a single package layout. Prefer documenting the latest version under 0.5/ as current; older folders (0.0–0.4) are historical evolution. Core modules: cqr_get.py (main GPIO monitoring loop), cqr_pdu.py (PDUManager for HTTP/SSH outlet control), cqr_sec.py (non-blocking pump-on timer), cqr_env.py (site config: PDU IP, credentials, outlet, intervals). Deployment target is a systemd service (pdu-manager) on Debian Bookworm with WiringPi/RPi.GPIO. Do not treat credential placeholders in cqr_env.py as real secrets; they are local site configuration templates.
repo_notes.author: awuehler

pages.title: Project Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to the tank-cq-level project: its purpose, hardware inventory, end-to-end automation loop, and version history. Links to child pages for hardware context and deployment.

pages.title: Hardware Inventory & System Architecture
pages.purpose: Describes all physical components required (Raspberry Pi Zero W, CQRobot optical sensor, ECO-WORTHY RV pump, Digital Web Loggers Smart PDU), how they interconnect, and the overall feedback loop from sensor detection to pump activation.

pages.title: Version History & Evolution
pages.purpose: Traces the project's development across versions 0.0 through 0.5: from the original C sample and Python port, through the proof-of-concept, modular refactor, PDUManager class introduction, deployment-ready 0.4, and the in-progress 0.5 refactor.

pages.title: Core Software Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of the modular Python architecture used from v0.2 onward: the four-file layout (cqr_env, cqr_get, cqr_pdu, cqr_sec), their responsibilities, and how they interact. Prefer 0.5/ as the current reference; older version folders are historical. Links to child pages for each module.

pages.title: Environment Configuration (cqr_env.py)
pages.purpose: Details the centralized configuration module present in versions 0.1–0.5. Covers all exported constants: PUMP_FEATURE, TANK_FEATURE, TIME_CHECKED, BOOL_OUTPUTS, and PDUS_SMARTLY, including their meaning, units, and how consuming modules use them.

pages.title: Main Monitoring Loop (cqr_get.py)
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the primary entry point script across versions. Covers GPIO initialization, the while-True polling loop, CQR_VALUE branching logic (0/1/error), PDU state queries, subprocess spawning of cqr_sec.py, graceful shutdown via KeyboardInterrupt, and the bootstrap pre-check in __main__.

pages.title: PDU Control Layer (cqr_pdu.py)
pages.purpose: Explains the PDU abstraction layer: the evolution from a standalone run_curl function (v0.2) to the PDUManager class (v0.3+). Covers run_curl, pdu_curl/pdu_url, HTTP and SSH protocols, the Digital Loggers REST API endpoints, Digest authentication, CSRF headers, JSON auto-detection, and the module-level instance binding pattern.

pages.title: Pump Timer (cqr_sec.py)
pages.purpose: Documents the countdown timer subprocess: the simple_timer function, how it is spawned as a non-blocking Popen child process, the countdown loop with 5-second interval logging, and the final PDU outlet OFF when the timer expires.

pages.title: GPIO & Sensor Integration
pages.purpose: Overview of how the Raspberry Pi GPIO interface is used to read the CQRobot water sensor, linking to child pages for the original C implementation and the Python port. Note known false-positive readings from clinging water droplets and the hydrophobic coating workaround.

pages.title: Original C Implementation (cqrobot.c)
pages.purpose: Covers the original WiringPi-based C program in 0.0/: wiringPiSetup, pinMode(1, INPUT), the digitalRead polling loop, and the binary liquid/no-liquid output. Explains why this served as the starting reference for the Python port.

pages.title: Python GPIO Port (cqrobot.py)
pages.purpose: Covers the RPi.GPIO-based Python translation in 0.0/: BCM pin numbering, GPIO.setup(18, GPIO.IN), the 1 Hz polling loop with time.sleep(1), the try/finally GPIO.cleanup() pattern, and the pin correction from 17 to 18 vs the C original.

pages.title: Deployment & Operations
pages.purpose: Guide for deploying the production code on a Raspberry Pi as a systemd service. Prefer 0.5/ (or 0.4 if still the installed path). Links to child pages for setup steps and runtime monitoring.

pages.title: systemd Service Setup
pages.purpose: Step-by-step instructions for installing the pdu-manager.service unit file: copying source to /usr/local/src/cqr-pdu, creating the service file under /etc/systemd/system/, enabling and starting the service, and verifying status with systemctl and journalctl.

pages.title: Runtime Configuration & Tuning
pages.purpose: Explains how to adjust cqr_env.py constants for a specific deployment: changing PDU IP/credentials in PDUS_SMARTLY, tuning TIME_CHECKED polling intervals, toggling BOOL_OUTPUTS verbosity, and understanding PUMP_FEATURE/TANK_FEATURE seed values. Also covers SSH public-key setup for Digital Loggers PDU access.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definition of any codebase-specific terms, hardware abbreviations, API concepts, and domain vocabulary used throughout the project. Each entry includes code pointers to relevant files and line references.
